property_summary: After any successful getTokens() call by a non-blacklisted caller with a valid value, the total token supply is conserved in the sense that totalDistributed + totalRemaining equals the immutable totalSupply (500000000e18) and never grows; the correct contract preserves this invariant, while the mutant increments totalRemaining instead of decrementing it, causing totalDistributed + totalRemaining to exceed totalSupply.
change_summary: Replace the totalRemaining decrement with an increment so remaining tokens grow instead of shrinking.
